-- Phase 2: bodies for picking a list element from an integer seed.
-- Same seed and same list always give the same element. No nondet, no random.

-- Index of the chosen element. Floor modulo keeps it in range for any seed.
index(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() > 0
  post out >= 0
  post out < xs.len()
  ex index([5, 6, 7], 5) == 2
  ex index([5, 6, 7], -1) == 2
  seed % xs.len()

-- The element at the chosen index.
pick(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() > 0
  post out == xs[index(xs, seed)]
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
  ex pick([42], 7) == 42
  xs[index(xs, seed)]
